svg.text: Local lichen/stage_2 working code | Stage 1 layout conventions retained | Added / changed classes have a blue header
Hollow triangle = inheritance; dashed triangle = realization.
Filled diamond = composition; hollow diamond = aggregation.
Dashed open arrow = dependency. Numbers are multiplicities.
Reference-valued fields may be represented by association roles.

StaffTeam owns staff; SeatingArea owns two Tables
Main passes customers::createCustomer as an IntFunction. CustomerFactory does not implement IntFunction, so there is no realization arrow
between them. The controller stores the function, not a concrete CustomerFactory.
Default seed 24369: Regular, VIP, Regular, Regular, Regular, Critic. Six arrivals: 1, 4, 7, 10, 13, 16. Critic chooses the longest preparation
time; ties use menu order. VIP discount is locked into the order bill.
